evidence.title: When a neural surrogate cannot accelerate a solver: runtime share, closed-loop drift, and the economics of uncertainty gating in a stiff coupled simulation

summary: Researchers analyze why neural surrogates sometimes fail to speed up solvers, citing runtime distribution, closed-loop drift, and uncertainty gating costs. The work highlights economic trade-offs in deploying AI for complex simulations.
title: Study Explores Limitations of Neural Surrogates in Accelerating Stiff Coupled Simulations
